author: Sonanonymous Sherpa
review_text: Tried esewa because my bank app wasn't working today. Deposited this huge sum and it went smooth. I guess as long as you are depositing cash on esewa its not going to ask you for anything. But as soon as I tried to pay my kids school fees it said that was above my limit. Customer service told me to update my Kyc and after that it was going to work after an hour. Waited for 2 hrs, and tried it, but the same problem. I called again they said asap. 26hrs later I m still waiting.. Thanks Nosewa
